title: Yiga's Dumb Diamond Burger
description: Dumb Diamond Burger is a mod that simply adds 3 Burgers into Minecraft, one explodes, one makes you invincible and the third one just has a diamond inside it.
body:
This mod adds 3 Burgers into minecraft which are craftable with a specific item (Diamond, Totem of Undying or TNT), Bread, Lettuce and a Steak.


The Diamond Burger itself isn't meant to be a useful, it's meant to be some sort of objective for minecraft challenges or something idk. It has a Nutrition Value of 8 (twice a Golden Apple) and gives 9.2 Saturation.

The TNT Burger explodes when you eat it, simple as that. Most of the time it kills you. 

The Invulnerability Burger makes you invincible for 5 minutes after you eat it.




This mod also adds ground lettuce which is craftable with 4 grass or can be found in grass patches.
